summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed a Form 6-K (material change report) on July 15, 2026, disclosing leadership updates announced July 13, 2026. Dr. Jeff Millard joins as EVP, Technical Operations; Dr. Alex Therien becomes EVP, Research & Development; Amanda Malone stepped down as Chief Scientific & Operating Officer. No deal terms, premium, or board advisor mentioned. Transition of operations from Victoria to Vancouver/Seattle. This is a routine senior role shift, not a forced departure or an activist trigger. Confidence low because the filing indicates planned evolution, not an abrupt event.
